rate_model_note: Flat amount per plaza. NOT distance-based. Passenger rates have no time-of-day or day-of-week variation; truck rates are daytime/overnight.
reprices_on: 1 January 2027 (board vote 2026-08-19); then every two years from 2029 by CPI-U, max 8%
source_note: The rates page embeds the '2027 Toll Rates by Plaza' table as JSON. Every passenger I-PASS / Pay By Plate / Invoice rate was checked equal, by plaza number, to the board-approved PDF https://agency.illinoistollway.com/documents/d/guest/2026-06_proposedrates-1 (titled 'Proposed', linked as '2027 Toll Rates').
payment_premium_note: Pay By Plate is 1.5x I-PASS and Invoice 2x (rounded to the nickel).
